summary: Completed Module 1 pretest and setup check with practical, production-aware answers.
evidence: Setup check on Windows + bash: node/npm/pnpm/git/docker/docker compose/curl available; python available via `python` and `pip`; `python3` alias missing in shell.
Health vs readiness: health = process alive; readiness = fully initialized and safe to serve requests.
Public redirect misuse: phishing via hidden malicious destination behind trusted short links.
500 triage first checks: logs/traces first, then recent code/deploy/config changes.
Idempotency: repeated execution yields same safe outcome; prevents duplicate side effects during retries.
Index tradeoff: index maintenance slows writes when data changes.
Testing preference: integration-heavy to catch cross-component issues unit tests can miss.
